checked_obligation: Verify that (1,1) solves t²−3y²=−2 and that multiplication by powers of 2+√3 preserves norm −2.
reason: Directly, 1²−3·1²=−2 and 2²−3·1²=1. For N(u+v√3)=u²−3v², direct expansion gives N(αβ)=N(α)N(β); hence N((t+y√3)(2+√3)^k)=−2·1^k=−2. The factors also have integer coefficients, so every product does as well. No external rule candidate is needed.
